text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Radar contact! Target acquired!
Closing in on target in 3, 2, 1...!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Trainer-chan, did you see, did you see~?
Maya's run~☆

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe~☆ Right, right?!
After all, Maya's the one you should be keeping your eyes on~♪

text_block_list.name: Reporter Otonashi
text_block_list.text:
"...Top Gun-san!
Mayano Top Gun-san!"

text_block_list.name: Reporter Otonashi
text_block_list.text:
I'm Otonashi from "Monthly Twinkle."
May I ask for your thoughts on the race?

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Whoa! An interview with Maya~!?
Sure thing~☆ I'll answer anything!

text_block_list.name: Reporter Otonashi
text_block_list.text:
Thank you very much.
Without further ado, then—

text_block_list.name: Reporter Otonashi
text_block_list.text:
After numerous trials, she arrived at this Kikuka Sho.
Running with a stride that seemed to declare
her true aptitude lay in long distances...

text_block_list.name: Reporter Otonashi
text_block_list.text:
Ah, I am terribly sorry.
Um, how should I put this...

text_block_list.name: Reporter Otonashi
text_block_list.text:
Mayano Top Gun's Classic challenge.
After all, the Kikuka Sho was her primary target, so—

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
? You don't have to correct yourself, you know?
Maya gets it.

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: “Still, I couldn't help but wonder 『why?』 though.”

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
I only ran the Kikuka-sho because I wanted to.
Brian-san was in that race, after all.

text_block_list.name: Reporter Otonashi
text_block_list.text:
"...Brian?
You mean *the* Narita Brian-san?"

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Yeah! Hey, hey, reporter!
Was Maya's running more exciting than Brian's?
Was it? Was it?!

text_block_list.name: Reporter Otonashi
text_block_list.text: Oho... My goodness.

text_block_list.name: Reporter Otonashi
text_block_list.text:
"You intend to challenge Brian-san!
My, what a development...!"

text_block_list.name: Reporter Otonashi
text_block_list.text:
Then let me ask you point-blank. In this year's Arima Kinen,
will you also be running, Mayano Top Gun-san?

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: The Arima Kinen? Maya is?

text_block_list.name: Reporter Otonashi
text_block_list.text: Yes, because the "Triple Crown Umamusume," Narita Brian-san, will be running in this year's Arima Kinen.

text_block_list.name: Reporter Otonashi
text_block_list.text: Then a direct showdown is unavoidable, isn't it?

The "Arima Kinen"... It's the grand race that closes out the year.
A stage that reflects both fan popularity
and current true strength in vivid detail.

Besides "Triple Crown Umamusume" Narita Brian,renowned Umamusume like the "Empress" Hishi Amazon
should have declared their entry as well.

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: Yeah, yeah, it's definitely coming out!

text_block_list.name: Reporter Otonashi
text_block_list.text:
Fufu. A giant star versus a rising star—whose light will shine brighter?
I have high hopes for this year's Arima Kinen.

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha♪ The next one's the Arima Kinen, huh!
Let's do our best, Trainer-chan☆
choice_data_list: Are you sure you want to go with the Arima Kinen?
Are you really sure about the Arima Kinen?

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Yeah. If I go there, I'll be able to race
against Brian-san directly, right?

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Nihihi, the moment I've been waiting for!
Now I can finally show everyone!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
That Maya can make you
way more excited than Brian-san can~♪
And so, the goal she had spoken of this spring was finally drawing within arm's reach...!
